text: Forwarding my holiday rental thread so you can help me reply. We booked a cottage in Cornwall for 5 nights from 12 July, 940 pounds in total, under the name Oluwaseun Adeyemi, booking ID CORN-5530-18. The owner, Mrs Gwen Treloar, cancelled 3 days before arrival because of a burst pipe and offered a 30% voucher instead of a refund. Our friend Hamid Rahimi has already paid 200 pounds towards the booking, so he wants his share back first. Gwen says formal notices must go to her letting agent at 14 Quay Lane, Falmouth TR11 3AA. We do not want the voucher. Please draft a firm message asking for a full refund of the 940 pounds within 7 days, and mention the 200 pounds owed to Hamid.
task: Draft a firm message asking for a full refund and mentioning the amount owed to our friend.
